title: Our timeline
premise: The history that actually happened, and one calm guess at what comes next.

temperate.caption: Early Pleistocene · mammoths graze a wooded floodplain
temperate.environment: A temperate floodplain of open woodland, tall grass and a slow, meandering river.
temperate.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to one million years ago, in the Early Pleistocene. A temperate landscape of open woodland, tall grasses and a meandering river. One southern mammoth (Mammuthus meridionalis) grazes, clearly visible in the mid-ground.

fauna.name: Southern mammoth
fauna.ancestor: early African mammoths that spread north
fauna.niche: Large browser and grazer of open woodland
fauna.where: Europe and western Asia, about 2.5 to 0.8 million years ago

adaptations.because: grit and grasses wear teeth down, so taller teeth last a lifetime
useful for stripping bark and pushing through branches

adaptations.trait: A thinner coat than later mammoths
adaptations.because: the climate was still mild, before the great ice ages deepened

arid.caption: Early Pleistocene · giraffe-cousins browse a dry savanna
arid.environment: A dry savanna of scattered acacias and a sandy, seasonal riverbed.
arid.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to one million years ago, in the Early Pleistocene. A dry, open savanna with scattered acacia trees, golden grass and a sandy seasonal riverbed. One Sivatherium, a massive short-necked giraffe relative with broad antler-like ossicones, stands clearly visible in the mid-ground.

fauna.name: Sivatherium
fauna.niche: Heavy browser of savanna trees and shrubs
fauna.where: Africa, from about 5 million to about 8,000 years ago

adaptations.because: display and sparring between rival males
it browsed low and mid-height plants instead of tall canopies
size protected it from the big cats of the savanna

tropical.caption: Early Pleistocene · a hoe-tusker wades the swamp edge
tropical.environment: Lush tropical woodland around a reedy swamp.
tropical.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to one million years ago, in the Early Pleistocene. Lush tropical woodland around a reedy swamp, palms and tall grasses, warm humid light. One Deinotherium, a huge elephant relative with tusks curving downward from its lower jaw, stands clearly visible in the mid-ground.

fauna.name: Deinotherium
fauna.ancestor: early proboscideans, distant cousins of elephants
fauna.where: Africa, until about 1 million years ago

adaptations.because: used to pull branches down and strip leaves and bark
walking long distances between forest patches
reaching foliage other browsers couldn't

cold.caption: Early Pleistocene · steppe mammoths cross the frost
cold.environment: A cold, open steppe with scattered larches and frost-hardened grass.
cold.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to one million years ago, in the Early Pleistocene. A cold, open steppe with scattered larch trees, frost on pale grass and a wide grey sky. One steppe mammoth (Mammuthus trogontherii), huge and shaggy, walks clearly visible in the mid-ground.

fauna.name: Steppe mammoth
fauna.where: Northern Eurasia, about 1.7 million to 200,000 years ago

adaptations.trait: Huge size, among the largest mammoths
adaptations.because: big bodies lose heat slowly

adaptations.trait: Grinding molars with many enamel plates
adaptations.because: tough, gritty steppe grass
the first long glacial winters

temperate.caption: End of the ice age · aurochs among birch and late snow
temperate.environment: Cold steppe giving way to birch and pine woodland, patches of late snow.
temperate.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to 10,000 years ago, at the end of the last ice age. Cold steppe giving way to birch and pine woodland, patches of late snow. One aurochs stands, clearly visible in the mid-ground.

fauna.name: Aurochs
fauna.niche: Large grazer of woodland edges and river meadows
fauna.where: Europe, Asia and North Africa; the last one died in Poland in 1627

adaptations.because: defence against wolves and fights between bulls
moving between woodland and open meadow

adaptations.trait: Mixed diet of grass and leaves
adaptations.because: the forests were spreading as the ice retreated

arid.caption: The Green Sahara · giant buffalo graze where desert is now
arid.environment: Where desert is today, a grassy savanna with shallow lakes.
arid.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to 10,000 years ago, during the humid period when today's deserts were green. A grassy savanna with a shallow lake, scattered trees and soft light. One Pelorovis, a giant buffalo with enormous curving horns, grazes clearly visible in the mid-ground.

fauna.name: Giant long-horned buffalo
fauna.where: Northern and eastern Africa, until a few thousand years ago

adaptations.because: display and defence on open grassland
plentiful grass during the Green Sahara
it vanished as the lakes dried up again

tropical.caption: Late Pleistocene · a giant ground sloth in the forest
tropical.environment: Warm forest edge with palms and open clearings.
tropical.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to 10,000 years ago. A warm forest edge with palms, ferns and an open clearing. One giant ground sloth (Megatherium), the size of an elephant, rears up to feed on leaves, clearly visible in the mid-ground.

fauna.name: Giant ground sloth
fauna.niche: Giant browser that stood on its hind legs to reach leaves
fauna.where: South America, until roughly 12,000 years ago

adaptations.because: pulling branches down to its mouth

adaptations.trait: A thick tail used as a prop
adaptations.because: standing upright to feed high in the trees
few predators could threaten an adult

cold.caption: End of the ice age · the last woolly mammoths
cold.environment: Tundra and mammoth steppe, low willows, lingering snow.
cold.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to 10,000 years ago, at the end of the last ice age. Open tundra and pale steppe grass, low willows, lingering snow under a wide sky. One woolly mammoth walks, clearly visible in the mid-ground.

fauna.name: Woolly mammoth
fauna.niche: Grazer of the cold mammoth steppe
fauna.where: Northern Eurasia and North America; the last ones lived on Wrangel Island until about 4,000 years ago

adaptations.trait: Dense woolly coat over an undercoat
adaptations.because: winters far below freezing

adaptations.trait: Small ears and a short tail
adaptations.because: less skin exposed to frostbite
energy stored for the long winter

eras.caption: The first century · modest homes and a carved stone
eras.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to the early first century. Modest buildings of local stone, mud brick or timber on the same footprints, a packed-earth road, simple fences and gardens, smoke from a hearth, no modern objects.
eras.visualPromptIndoor: Transform this room to the early first century: rough plaster and timber walls, a packed-earth floor, a low wooden bench, clay pots, daylight from a small opening.

fossil.brief: A carved limestone relief panel of a harvest festival: a woman holding a basket of fruit, sheaves of wheat, a ram, and a border of grapevines. Weathered stone, soft relief carving, no inscription, no letters, no text of any kind.
fossil.slogan: Felicitas temporum · the happiness of the times

elements.name: woman
elements.explanation: Plenty itself, shown as a calm, generous figure

elements.name: wheat
elements.explanation: Full harvests promise that the order of things works

elements.name: grapevine
elements.explanation: The border makes the whole scene feel fertile

eras.caption: 1526 · an old town and a painted shop sign
eras.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to the year 1526. The town as it was then, built in the region's own traditional architecture and materials on the same footprints, unpaved ground, no modern objects, no electricity, no vehicles, daylight only.
eras.visualPromptIndoor: Transform this room to the year 1526: timber beams, plaster walls, a wooden bench and chair, a woven rug, candles, a small leaded window.

fossil.brief: A painted wooden bakery sign hanging from a wrought-iron bracket: two crossed loaves of bread, a golden wheat sheaf and a crown-shaped pretzel on a deep red field, gilded edges, weathered paint. No letters, no words, no text of any kind.

elements.name: bread
elements.explanation: Most people couldn't read; pictures said what was sold

elements.name: pretzel
elements.explanation: A shared symbol signalled a trusted, regulated trade

elements.name: gold frame
elements.explanation: Gold paint claimed wealth and respectability

eras.caption: 1926 · an older town and a public-health poster
eras.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to the year 1926. The buildings of that time in the region's own style on the same footprints, period street details, a few vintage cars, soft period light.
eras.visualPromptIndoor: Transform this room to the year 1926: patterned wallpaper, a wooden sideboard, an upholstered armchair, a gas lamp, lace curtains.

fossil.brief: A 1920s public-health poster encouraging people to drink clean water: a stylized woman pouring water from a pitcher, a glowing sun behind her, a geometric Art Deco border, bold flat colours, paper texture. No text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no writing of any kind.

elements.name: woman
elements.explanation: Hygiene shown as the graceful thing a modern person does

elements.name: sun
elements.explanation: The glow borrows the language of saints for a public-health habit

elements.name: water
elements.explanation: Clear, flowing water stands for health and progress

eras.caption: 2126 · green roofs, quiet trams, gardens on every street
eras.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to the year 2126. The same buildings, refurbished with green roofs, climbing plants and solar facades, quiet electric trams and wide tree-lined walkways. Peaceful, sunlit, optimistic.
eras.visualPromptIndoor: Transform this room to the year 2126: the same layout, warm natural materials, plants along the window, soft integrated lighting, simple elegant furniture. Peaceful and sunlit.

fossil.brief: A softly glowing illuminated street panel showing hands planting a seedling in rich soil, surrounded by stylized leaves and sun rays, clean modern illustration in green and gold. No letters, no words, no text of any kind.

elements.name: hands
elements.explanation: Anonymous hands invite anyone to see themselves in the act

elements.name: seedling
elements.explanation: Something small and fragile that you can help grow

elements.name: sun
elements.explanation: Light frames the message as a good, natural direction

eras.caption: 3026 · the city has grown into a garden
eras.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to 1,000 years in the future. The same buildings, lovingly preserved and grown into a living garden city: terraces, balconies and roofs planted with trees, ivy and flowering vines, footpaths through meadows and ponds where the roads were. Peaceful, sunlit, cared for.
eras.visualPromptIndoor: Transform this room to 1,000 years in the future: the same room, cared for and full of plants, ivy on the walls, a small tree by the sunlit window. Peaceful and calm.

temperate.caption: 10,000 years on · old forest over quiet green mounds
temperate.environment: Old-growth forest growing over low, mossy mounds where buildings once stood.
temperate.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to 10,000 years in the future. A wild, peaceful old-growth forest; only low mossy mounds and a few weathered stones hint that anything ever stood here. One large ground-dwelling raven, long-legged and glossy black, walks across a clearing, clearly visible in the mid-ground. Sunlit and serene.

adaptations.because: food is on the ground and few predators remain to flee from
cracking nuts and digging for grubs in soft soil
ravens were already problem-solvers; that paid off

arid.caption: 10,000 years on · scrub and stone where streets were
arid.environment: Rocky scrubland with low stone mounds and hardy shrubs.
arid.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to 10,000 years in the future. A quiet, open scrubland of hardy shrubs, warm sand and low weathered stone mounds where buildings once stood. One long-legged pale desert fox with huge ears trots across the ground, clearly visible in the mid-ground. Golden, peaceful light.

adaptations.because: covering great distances between scattered prey
shedding heat and hearing prey underground
staying cool under a harsh sun

tropical.caption: 10,000 years on · rainforest over vine-covered stones
tropical.environment: Dense rainforest with vine-covered stone mounds.
tropical.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to 10,000 years in the future. A dense, peaceful rainforest with tall trees, hanging vines and vine-covered stone mounds where buildings once stood. One brilliantly green gliding parakeet with wide skin flaps between its legs glides between branches, clearly visible in the mid-ground. Soft green light.

adaptations.because: gliding between trees costs less energy than flapping
cracking hard rainforest seeds
camouflage among the leaves

cold.caption: 10,000 years on · tundra over low mounds
cold.environment: Open tundra and dwarf birch over low mounds.
cold.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to 10,000 years in the future. Open, peaceful tundra with dwarf birch, lichen and low grassy mounds where buildings once stood. One shaggy, long-haired reindeer descendant with broad flat antlers grazes, clearly visible in the mid-ground. Soft northern light.

fauna.name: Shag deer
fauna.niche: Grazer of lichen and tundra grass

adaptations.because: colder winters after a long warm period
clearing snow from lichen
walking on snow and soft bog

temperate.caption: One million years on · a new forest, new creatures
temperate.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to one million years in the future. A lush, unfamiliar ecosystem has evolved where the structures once stood. One speculative creature descended from the pigeon, much larger, flightless and long-legged, stands clearly visible in the mid-ground.

fauna.name: Strider pigeon
fauna.niche: Tall, flightless browser of shrubs and seeds

adaptations.because: flying is expensive when food is on the ground and predators are few
bigger bodies reach more food and lose heat slowly
inherited from pigeons, now doing heavier work

arid.caption: One million years on · hopping rats on the red plain
arid.environment: A wide, open red plain with strange succulents.
arid.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to one million years in the future. A wide, open red-earth plain with strange tall succulents where the structures once stood, warm golden light. One speculative kangaroo-like hopping rat, the size of a dog, with long hind legs and a balancing tail, stands clearly visible in the mid-ground.

fauna.name: Hopping rat
fauna.niche: Grazer that travels far between sparse plants

adaptations.because: the most efficient way to cross open ground
steering and stability at speed
very little to drink on the plain

tropical.caption: One million years on · giant herons browse tree ferns
tropical.environment: A misty forest of giant tree ferns.
tropical.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to one million years in the future. A misty, peaceful forest of giant tree ferns and broad-leaved plants where the structures once stood. One speculative giant long-necked heron descendant, taller than a person, browses fern fronds, clearly visible in the mid-ground.

adaptations.because: reaching the tender fronds at the top of tree ferns
shearing leaves instead of spearing fish
plentiful food on foot made flying unnecessary

cold.caption: One million years on · seals that walk the shore
cold.environment: A cold coast of moss, rock and pale grass.
cold.visualPrompt: Transform this scene to one million years in the future. A cold, peaceful landscape of moss, rock and pale grass where the structures once stood, low silver light. One speculative seal descendant that walks on land on four sturdy flippers, with thick grey fur, stands clearly visible in the mid-ground.

adaptations.because: more food on land than in a colder sea
long freezing winters
finding prey under snow
